author: Ryan Daws
description:
OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 model family is now available in Kiro, the AWS agentic coding service built for spec-driven development and testing. The update brings three models from OpenAI’s latest flagship series – Sol, Terra, and Luna – into Kiro. AWS and OpenAI describe the pairing as a way to help developers produce code with fewer iterations […]

The post AWS adds OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 to Kiro’s agentic coding workflow appeared first on Developer Tech News.
title: AWS adds OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 to Kiro’s agentic coding workflow
